items.title: Russia and China exploring joint weapons development and production
items.summary: Dmitry Shugaev, head of Russia's Federal Service for Military-Technical Cooperation, said Moscow and Beijing are exploring opportunities to jointly develop and manufacture weapons. No specific projects, agreements or timelines were announced in the reported remarks.

items.title: Russian strike assessment describes greater use of ballistic missiles in Ukraine
items.summary: A Russian military-focused assessment of recent strikes across Ukraine says ballistic missiles received greater emphasis, while jet-powered and propeller-driven drones were used in roughly equal numbers. It describes jet-powered drones as primarily targeting western and central Ukraine, without providing a detailed tally.
